ko.title: 1조 2,000억 달러와 하나의 법적 질문: 트럼프의 5,000달러 중간선거 "배당금" 공약 집중 조명

segments.src: ## A Big Promise, Tied to a Ballot Box Outcome
segments.tr: ## 투표함 결과와 연계된 거대한 공약

segments.src: President Trump has pledged that every American adult would receive a $5,000 payment — a so-called "dividend" — if Republicans retain control of both chambers of Congress in the November midterm elections.
segments.tr: 트럼프 대통령은 오는 11월 중간선거에서 공화당이 의회의 상·하원 모두의 통제권을 유지할 경우, 모든 미국 성인에게 5,000달러의 지급금(소위 "배당금")을 지급하겠다고 공언했습니다.

segments.src: The proposal, floated as part of a broader argument that tariff revenue collected over the past several years has generated a windfall for the federal government, has quickly become one of the most talked-about economic storylines heading into the fall campaign season.
segments.tr: 지난 수년간 징수된 관세 수입이 연방 정부에 뜻밖의 횡재를 가져다주었다는 광범위한 주장의 일환으로 제기된 이 제안은 가을 선거전 시즌을 앞두고 가장 많이 논의되는 경제적 화제 중 하나로 빠르게 떠올랐습니다.

segments.src: Supporters frame the payment as a straightforward return of money already collected through tariffs on imported goods, arguing that if consumers and businesses have effectively borne the cost of those tariffs, it is only fair that some of that revenue flow back to households.
segments.tr: 지지자들은 이번 지급을 수입품에 부과된 관세를 통해 이미 징수된 돈을 정당하게 돌려주는 것으로 규정하며, 소비자와 기업이 이러한 관세 비용을 실질적으로 부담했다면 그 수입의 일부가 가계로 돌아가는 것이 당연하다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Critics, however, say the math, the funding mechanism, and the political framing of the offer all raise serious questions that go well beyond a typical stimulus debate.
segments.tr: 그러나 비판론자들은 계산법, 재원 조달 방식, 제안의 정치적 프레임 모두가 일반적인 경기 부양책 논쟁을 훨씬 넘어서는 심각한 의문을 제기한다고 말합니다.

segments.src: ## The Price Tag: Roughly $1.2 Trillion
segments.tr: ## 예상 비용: 약 1조 2,000억 달러

segments.src: With more than 230 million adults in the United States, a flat $5,000 payment to each one would cost in the neighborhood of $1.2 trillion — a figure that dwarfs even the largest single rounds of pandemic-era stimulus payments.
segments.tr: 미국의 성인 인구가 2억 3,000만 명을 넘어서는 상황에서, 각 개인에게 5,000달러씩 일률적으로 지급하려면 약 1조 2,000억 달러가 소요됩니다. 이는 팬데믹 시절 가장 규모가 컸던 단일 재난지원금 액수조차 압도하는 수치입니다.

segments.src: Independent budget analysts have noted that tariff revenue collected to date, while substantial, falls well short of covering a payout at that scale without either new borrowing, cuts elsewhere in the federal budget, or a significant and sustained increase in tariff collections.
segments.tr: 독립적인 예산 분석가들은 지금까지 징수된 관세 수입이 상당한 금액이기는 하지만, 신규 채무 발행, 연방 예산의 다른 부분 삭감, 또는 관세 징수액의 지속적이고 대폭적인 증가 없이는 이 정도 규모의 지급을 충당하기에 턱없이 부족하다고 지적했습니다.

segments.src: That gap is at the center of the fiscal debate.
segments.tr: 이러한 격차가 재정 논쟁의 핵심입니다.

segments.src: Economists across the political spectrum have cautioned that tariffs are ultimately paid in large part by American importers and consumers through higher prices, meaning a "dividend" funded this way could function less like a windfall rebate and more like a redistribution of costs that were already being passed on to the public.
segments.tr: 정치적 스펙트럼을 넘나드는 경제학자들은 관세가 결국 가격 인상을 통해 미국 수입업자와 소비자에 의해 주로 지불된다는 점을 경고해 왔으며, 이는 이러한 방식으로 조달된 "배당금"이 횡재 환급보다는 이미 대중에게 전가되고 있던 비용의 재분배처럼 작동할 수 있음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: Others have raised concerns about inflationary pressure if a payment of this size were to reach the economy all at once.
segments.tr: 다른 이들은 이 정도 규모의 자금이 한꺼번에 경제에 유입될 경우 발생할 인플레이션 압력에 대해 우려를 표명했습니다.

segments.src: ## The Legal Question: Can a Payment Be Tied to an Election Outcome?
segments.tr: ## 법적 질문: 지급금이 선거 결과와 연계될 수 있는가?

segments.src: Beyond the budget arithmetic, the proposal has drawn scrutiny over a more fundamental issue: whether explicitly conditioning a federal payment on the outcome of a congressional election crosses a legal line.
segments.tr: 예산 산출을 넘어, 이 제안은 보다 근본적인 문제, 즉 연방 지급금을 의회 선거 결과와 명시적으로 연계하는 것이 법적 선을 넘는지 여부에 대해 엄격한 검토를 받고 있습니다.

segments.src: Federal law generally prohibits offering or providing something of value in exchange for voting, or for voting a particular way, and election law specialists have pointed out that a pledge structured as "you get this payment if this party wins" sits in genuinely untested legal territory.
segments.tr: 연방법은 일반적으로 투표행위 또는 특정 방식의 투표에 대한 대가로 가치 있는 것을 제공하거나 제안하는 것을 금지하고 있으며, 선거법 전문가들은 "특정 정당이 승리하면 이 지급금을 받게 된다"는 구조의 공약이 검증되지 않은 법적 영역에 위치한다고 지적했습니다.

segments.src: Legal scholars are divided on how such a case would actually be analyzed.
segments.tr: 법학자들은 이러한 사건이 실제로 어떻게 분석될지에 대해 의견이 갈리고 있습니다.

segments.src: Some argue that a broad policy promise made during a campaign — even one tied to a partisan outcome — is protected political speech and fundamentally different from an illegal offer to an individual voter in exchange for a specific ballot.
segments.tr: 일각에서는 캠페인 기간 동안 이루어진 광범위한 정책 공약(당파적 결과와 연계된 공약이라 할지라도)은 보호받는 정치적 표현의 자유이며, 특정 표를 대가로 개별 유권자에게 제공하는 불법적 제안과는 근본적으로 다르다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Others counter that the scale, specificity, and direct linkage to control of Congress make this proposal different from ordinary campaign promises about future legislation, and that it deserves close examination by election law authorities and, potentially, the courts.
segments.tr: 반면 다른 이들은 구체성, 규모, 그리고 의회 통제권과의 직접적인 연계성 때문에 이 제안이 향후 입법에 대한 일반적인 선거 공약과 다르며, 선거법 당국과 법원에 의해 면밀히 검토될 필요가 있다고 반박합니다.

segments.src: ## Bipartisan Pushback
segments.tr: ## 초당적인 반발

segments.src: The reaction has not broken along entirely predictable lines.
segments.tr: 이에 대한 반응이 완전히 예상 가능한 정당 노선대로 갈라진 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: While Democratic lawmakers have criticized the plan as fiscally irresponsible and legally dubious, a number of Republican members of Congress and fiscal conservatives have also voiced skepticism — some questioning whether the federal government can responsibly fund a trillion-dollar-plus payment without deepening the deficit, and others expressing discomfort with a proposal that so explicitly ties a taxpayer payment to their own party's electoral success.
segments.tr: 민주당 의원들은 이 계획을 재정적으로 무책임하고 법적으로 의심스럽다고 비판한 반면, 다수의 공화당 의원과 재정 보수주의자들 역시 회의론을 제기했습니다. 일부는 연방 정부가 적자를 심화시키지 않고 1조 달러가 넘는 돈을 책임 있게 조달할 수 있는지 물었고, 다른 이들은 납세자에 대한 지급금을 자당의 선거 승리와 이처럼 명시적으로 연계하는 제안에 불편함을 표명했습니다.

segments.src: Congressional appropriators have noted that any payment of this size would almost certainly require legislation, meaning the pledge itself cannot be unilaterally implemented by the executive branch regardless of the November results.
segments.tr: 의회 예산 담당자들은 이 정도 규모의 금액 지급에는 거의 확실히 법률 제정이 필요하며, 이는 11월 결과와 상관없이 행정부가 이 공약을 단독으로 이행할 수 없음을 의미한다고 지적했습니다.

segments.src: That reality has led some observers to describe the promise as more of a campaign message than a fully formed policy proposal at this stage.
segments.tr: 이러한 현실 때문에 일부 관측통들은 이 공약이 현 단계에서 구체화된 정책 제안이라기보다는 캠페인 메시지에 가깝다고 평가합니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 향후 전망

segments.src: For now, the $5,000 dividend remains a pledge rather than enacted policy.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 5,000달러 배당금이 확정된 정책이 아니라 공약으로 남아 있습니다.

segments.src: Whether it advances will depend on the makeup of the next Congress, the willingness of lawmakers from both parties to bring it to a vote, and how election law questions around its framing are ultimately resolved.
segments.tr: 이 공약이 추진될지 여부는 차기 의회의 구성, 양당 의원들이 이를 표결에 붙일 의지가 있는지, 그리고 프레임 형성 둘러싼 선거법상의 질문들이 궁극적으로 어떻게 해결되는지에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: In the meantime, it has already reshaped part of the midterm conversation, forcing candidates in both parties to answer questions about tariff policy, federal spending, and the boundaries of what a campaign can promise voters in exchange for their support.
segments.tr: 한편, 이 제안은 이미 중간선거 대화의 일부를 재편하여 양당 후보자들로 하여금 관세 정책, 연방 지출, 그리고 지지를 대가로 캠페인이 유권자에게 공약할 수 있는 한계에 대한 질문에 답하도록 만들고 있습니다.

segments.src: As with any major fiscal proposal introduced ahead of an election, voters are encouraged to look past the headline number and examine the underlying funding mechanism, the legislative steps required, and the independent analyses of its costs and legal standing before drawing conclusions about its likelihood or fairness.
segments.tr: 선거를 앞두고 제기된 다른 주요 재정 제안과 마찬가지로, 유권자들은 실현 가능성이나 정당성에 대한 결론을 내리기 전에 헤드라인 수치 너머에 있는 근본적인 재원 조달 방식, 필요한 입법 절차, 그리고 비용 및 법적 지위에 대한 독립적인 분석을 검토할 것이 권장됩니다.

zh.title: $1.2 万亿与一个法律问题：深入了解特朗普的 5,000 美元中期选举“红利”承诺

segments.src: ## A Big Promise, Tied to a Ballot Box Outcome
segments.tr: ## 一个与投票结果挂钩的重大承诺

segments.src: President Trump has pledged that every American adult would receive a $5,000 payment — a so-called "dividend" — if Republicans retain control of both chambers of Congress in the November midterm elections.
segments.tr: 特朗普总统承诺，如果共和党在 11 月的中期选举中保住国会两院的控制权，每一位美国成年人都将获得 5,000 美元的款项——即所谓的“红利”。

segments.src: The proposal, floated as part of a broader argument that tariff revenue collected over the past several years has generated a windfall for the federal government, has quickly become one of the most talked-about economic storylines heading into the fall campaign season.
segments.tr: 该提案作为一项更广泛论点的一部分被提出，即过去几年征收的关税收入为联邦政府带来了意外之财，它已迅速成为秋季竞选季中最受关注的经济话题之一。

segments.src: Supporters frame the payment as a straightforward return of money already collected through tariffs on imported goods, arguing that if consumers and businesses have effectively borne the cost of those tariffs, it is only fair that some of that revenue flow back to households.
segments.tr: 支持者将这笔款项描述为对通过进口商品关税已征收资金的直接返还，他们认为，如果消费者和企业实际上承担了这些关税的成本，那么将部分收入返还给家庭是公平的。

segments.src: Critics, however, say the math, the funding mechanism, and the political framing of the offer all raise serious questions that go well beyond a typical stimulus debate.
segments.tr: 然而，批评者表示，该提议的计算方式、资金机制以及政治框架都引发了远超典型刺激计划辩论的严重问题。

segments.src: ## The Price Tag: Roughly $1.2 Trillion
segments.tr: ## 价格标签：约 1.2 万亿美元

segments.src: With more than 230 million adults in the United States, a flat $5,000 payment to each one would cost in the neighborhood of $1.2 trillion — a figure that dwarfs even the largest single rounds of pandemic-era stimulus payments.
segments.tr: 美国有超过 2.3 亿成年人，向每人发放 5,000 美元的固定款项将耗资约 1.2 万亿美元——这一数字甚至超过了疫情期间最大规模的单轮刺激计划。

segments.src: Independent budget analysts have noted that tariff revenue collected to date, while substantial, falls well short of covering a payout at that scale without either new borrowing, cuts elsewhere in the federal budget, or a significant and sustained increase in tariff collections.
segments.tr: 独立预算分析师指出，迄今为止征收的关税收入虽然可观，但远不足以在不进行新的借贷、削减联邦预算其他开支或大幅且持续增加关税征收的情况下覆盖如此规模的支出。

segments.src: That gap is at the center of the fiscal debate.
segments.tr: 这一缺口是财政辩论的核心。

segments.src: Economists across the political spectrum have cautioned that tariffs are ultimately paid in large part by American importers and consumers through higher prices, meaning a "dividend" funded this way could function less like a windfall rebate and more like a redistribution of costs that were already being passed on to the public.
segments.tr: 各政治派别的经济学家都警告称，关税最终在很大程度上是由美国进口商和消费者通过更高的价格来支付的，这意味着以这种方式资助的“红利”可能不像意外之财的回扣，而更像是对已经转嫁给公众的成本的重新分配。

segments.src: Others have raised concerns about inflationary pressure if a payment of this size were to reach the economy all at once.
segments.tr: 其他人则担心，如果如此规模的款项一次性进入经济体，会产生通胀压力。

segments.src: ## The Legal Question: Can a Payment Be Tied to an Election Outcome?
segments.tr: ## 法律问题：付款可以与选举结果挂钩吗？

segments.src: Beyond the budget arithmetic, the proposal has drawn scrutiny over a more fundamental issue: whether explicitly conditioning a federal payment on the outcome of a congressional election crosses a legal line.
segments.tr: 除了预算算术之外，该提案还因一个更根本的问题受到了审查：明确将联邦付款与国会选举结果挂钩是否触犯了法律底线。

segments.src: Federal law generally prohibits offering or providing something of value in exchange for voting, or for voting a particular way, and election law specialists have pointed out that a pledge structured as "you get this payment if this party wins" sits in genuinely untested legal territory.
segments.tr: 联邦法律通常禁止以投票或以特定方式投票为交换条件提供有价值的东西，选举法专家指出，这种结构为“如果该党获胜，你就能得到这笔钱”的承诺处于真正未经测试的法律领域。

segments.src: Legal scholars are divided on how such a case would actually be analyzed.
segments.tr: 法律学者对于如何实际分析此类案件存在分歧。

segments.src: Some argue that a broad policy promise made during a campaign — even one tied to a partisan outcome — is protected political speech and fundamentally different from an illegal offer to an individual voter in exchange for a specific ballot.
segments.tr: 一些人认为，竞选期间做出的广泛政策承诺——即使是与党派结果挂钩的承诺——属于受保护的政治言论，与以特定选票为交换条件向个人选民提出的非法提议有着本质区别。

segments.src: Others counter that the scale, specificity, and direct linkage to control of Congress make this proposal different from ordinary campaign promises about future legislation, and that it deserves close examination by election law authorities and, potentially, the courts.
segments.tr: 另一些人则反驳说，其规模、具体性以及与国会控制权的直接联系使得该提案不同于关于未来立法的普通竞选承诺，它值得选举法机构以及潜在的法院进行密切审查。

segments.src: ## Bipartisan Pushback
segments.tr: ## 两党抵制

segments.src: The reaction has not broken along entirely predictable lines.
segments.tr: 反应并非完全沿着可预测的路线分裂。

segments.src: While Democratic lawmakers have criticized the plan as fiscally irresponsible and legally dubious, a number of Republican members of Congress and fiscal conservatives have also voiced skepticism — some questioning whether the federal government can responsibly fund a trillion-dollar-plus payment without deepening the deficit, and others expressing discomfort with a proposal that so explicitly ties a taxpayer payment to their own party's electoral success.
segments.tr: 虽然民主党议员批评该计划在财政上不负责任且在法律上令人怀疑，但一些共和党国会议员和财政保守派也表达了怀疑——一些人质疑联邦政府在不加深赤字的情况下能否负责任地资助超过万亿美元的支出，另一些人则对一项如此明确地将纳税人付款与本党选举成功挂钩的提案表示不安。

segments.src: Congressional appropriators have noted that any payment of this size would almost certainly require legislation, meaning the pledge itself cannot be unilaterally implemented by the executive branch regardless of the November results.
segments.tr: 国会拨款委员会成员指出，任何如此规模的付款几乎肯定需要立法，这意味着无论 11 月的结果如何，该承诺本身都无法由行政部门单方面实施。

segments.src: That reality has led some observers to describe the promise as more of a campaign message than a fully formed policy proposal at this stage.
segments.tr: 这一现实导致一些观察家将这一承诺描述为现阶段的竞选信息，而非完全形成的政策提案。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: For now, the $5,000 dividend remains a pledge rather than enacted policy.
segments.tr: 目前，5,000 美元的红利仍然只是一个承诺，而非已颁布的政策。

segments.src: Whether it advances will depend on the makeup of the next Congress, the willingness of lawmakers from both parties to bring it to a vote, and how election law questions around its framing are ultimately resolved.
segments.tr: 它能否推进将取决于下一届国会的构成、两党议员将其付诸表决的意愿，以及围绕其框架的选举法问题最终如何解决。

segments.src: In the meantime, it has already reshaped part of the midterm conversation, forcing candidates in both parties to answer questions about tariff policy, federal spending, and the boundaries of what a campaign can promise voters in exchange for their support.
segments.tr: 与此同时，它已经重塑了中期选举对话的一部分，迫使两党候选人回答有关关税政策、联邦支出以及竞选活动在换取选民支持时可以承诺的界限等问题。

segments.src: As with any major fiscal proposal introduced ahead of an election, voters are encouraged to look past the headline number and examine the underlying funding mechanism, the legislative steps required, and the independent analyses of its costs and legal standing before drawing conclusions about its likelihood or fairness.
segments.tr: 与选举前提出的任何重大财政提案一样，我们鼓励选民透过标题数字，审查其潜在的资金机制、所需的立法步骤，以及对其成本和法律地位的独立分析，然后再对其可能性或公平性得出结论。

hi.title: $1.2 Trillion and One Legal Question: Inside Trump's $5,000 Midterm "Dividend" Pledge

segments.src: ## A Big Promise, Tied to a Ballot Box Outcome
segments.tr: ## A Big Promise, Tied to a Ballot Box Outcome

segments.src: President Trump has pledged that every American adult would receive a $5,000 payment — a so-called "dividend" — if Republicans retain control of both chambers of Congress in the November midterm elections.
segments.tr: राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प ने प्रतिज्ञा की है कि यदि नवंबर के मध्यावधि चुनावों में रिपब्लिकन कांग्रेस के दोनों सदनों पर नियंत्रण बनाए रखते हैं, तो प्रत्येक अमेरिकी वयस्क को $5,000 का भुगतान — जिसे तथाकथित "लाभांश" कहा जाता है — प्राप्त होगा।

segments.src: The proposal, floated as part of a broader argument that tariff revenue collected over the past several years has generated a windfall for the federal government, has quickly become one of the most talked-about economic storylines heading into the fall campaign season.
segments.tr: इस प्रस्ताव को, इस व्यापक तर्क के हिस्से के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया गया है कि पिछले कई वर्षों में एकत्र किए गए टैरिफ राजस्व ने संघीय सरकार के लिए एक बड़ा लाभ उत्पन्न किया है, और यह शरद ऋतु के अभियान के मौसम में सबसे अधिक चर्चित आर्थिक कथाओं में से एक बन गया है।

segments.src: Supporters frame the payment as a straightforward return of money already collected through tariffs on imported goods, arguing that if consumers and businesses have effectively borne the cost of those tariffs, it is only fair that some of that revenue flow back to households.
segments.tr: समर्थकों ने इस भुगतान को आयातित वस्तुओं पर टैरिफ के माध्यम से पहले ही एकत्र किए गए धन की एक सीधी वापसी के रूप में तैयार किया है, यह तर्क देते हुए कि यदि उपभोक्ताओं और व्यवसायों ने उन टैरिफ की लागत को प्रभावी ढंग से उठाया है, तो यह केवल उचित है कि उस राजस्व का कुछ हिस्सा परिवारों के पास वापस आए।

segments.src: Critics, however, say the math, the funding mechanism, and the political framing of the offer all raise serious questions that go well beyond a typical stimulus debate.
segments.tr: हालाँकि, आलोचकों का कहना है कि गणित, वित्त पोषण तंत्र और प्रस्ताव का राजनीतिक ढांचा सभी ऐसे गंभीर प्रश्न उठाते हैं जो एक सामान्य प्रोत्साहन बहस से कहीं आगे जाते हैं।

segments.src: ## The Price Tag: Roughly $1.2 Trillion
segments.tr: ## The Price Tag: Roughly $1.2 Trillion

segments.src: With more than 230 million adults in the United States, a flat $5,000 payment to each one would cost in the neighborhood of $1.2 trillion — a figure that dwarfs even the largest single rounds of pandemic-era stimulus payments.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में 230 मिलियन से अधिक वयस्कों के साथ, प्रत्येक को $5,000 का एक समान भुगतान करने पर लगभग $1.2 ट्रिलियन का खर्च आएगा — एक ऐसा आंकड़ा जो महामारी के दौर के सबसे बड़े एकल दौर के प्रोत्साहन भुगतानों को भी बौना कर देता है।

segments.src: Independent budget analysts have noted that tariff revenue collected to date, while substantial, falls well short of covering a payout at that scale without either new borrowing, cuts elsewhere in the federal budget, or a significant and sustained increase in tariff collections.
segments.tr: स्वतंत्र बजट विश्लेषकों ने नोट किया है कि आज तक एकत्र किया गया टैरिफ राजस्व, हालांकि पर्याप्त है, नए उधार, संघीय बजट में अन्य कटौती, या टैरिफ संग्रह में एक महत्वपूर्ण और निरंतर वृद्धि के बिना उस पैमाने पर भुगतान को कवर करने से बहुत कम है।

segments.src: That gap is at the center of the fiscal debate.
segments.tr: वह अंतर राजकोषीय बहस के केंद्र में है।

segments.src: Economists across the political spectrum have cautioned that tariffs are ultimately paid in large part by American importers and consumers through higher prices, meaning a "dividend" funded this way could function less like a windfall rebate and more like a redistribution of costs that were already being passed on to the public.
segments.tr: राजनीतिक स्पेक्ट्रम के अर्थशास्त्रियों ने चेतावनी दी है कि टैरिफ अंततः अमेरिकी आयातकों और उच्च कीमतों के माध्यम से उपभोक्ताओं द्वारा बड़े पैमाने पर भुगतान किए जाते हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि इस तरह से वित्त पोषित "लाभांश" एक अप्रत्याशित रिbate की तरह कम और उन लागतों के पुनर्वितरण की तरह अधिक काम कर सकता है जो जनता को पहले ही दी जा रही थीं।

segments.src: Others have raised concerns about inflationary pressure if a payment of this size were to reach the economy all at once.
segments.tr: अन्य लोगों ने मुद्रास्फीति के दबाव के बारे में चिंता जताई है यदि इस आकार का भुगतान एक बार में अर्थव्यवस्था तक पहुंच जाए।

segments.src: ## The Legal Question: Can a Payment Be Tied to an Election Outcome?
segments.tr: ## The Legal Question: Can a Payment Be Tied to an Election Outcome?

segments.src: Beyond the budget arithmetic, the proposal has drawn scrutiny over a more fundamental issue: whether explicitly conditioning a federal payment on the outcome of a congressional election crosses a legal line.
segments.tr: बजट अंकगणित से परे, इस प्रस्ताव ने एक अधिक मौलिक मुद्दे पर जांच आकर्षित की है: क्या कांग्रेस के चुनाव के परिणाम के लिए संघीय भुगतान को स्पष्ट रूप से शर्त बनाना कानूनी रेखा को पार करता है।

segments.src: Federal law generally prohibits offering or providing something of value in exchange for voting, or for voting a particular way, and election law specialists have pointed out that a pledge structured as "you get this payment if this party wins" sits in genuinely untested legal territory.
segments.tr: संघीय कानून आम तौर पर वोट देने के बदले में, या किसी विशेष तरीके से वोट देने के बदले में मूल्य की कोई चीज़ देने या प्रदान करने पर प्रतिबंध लगाता है, और चुनाव कानून विशेषज्ञों ने बताया है कि "यदि यह पार्टी जीतती है तो आपको यह भुगतान मिलता है" के रूप में संरचित एक प्रतिज्ञा वास्तविक रूप से untested कानूनी क्षेत्र में बैठती है।

segments.src: Legal scholars are divided on how such a case would actually be analyzed.
segments.tr: कानूनी विद्वान इस बात पर विभाजित हैं कि इस तरह के मामले का वास्तव में विश्लेषण कैसे किया जाएगा।

segments.src: Some argue that a broad policy promise made during a campaign — even one tied to a partisan outcome — is protected political speech and fundamentally different from an illegal offer to an individual voter in exchange for a specific ballot.
segments.tr: कुछ लोगों का तर्क है कि एक अभियान के दौरान किया गया एक व्यापक नीतिगत वादा — यहां तक कि एक पक्षपातपूर्ण परिणाम से बंधा हुआ — संरक्षित राजनीतिक भाषण है और एक विशिष्ट मतदान के बदले में एक व्यक्तिगत मतदाता को दिए गए अवैध प्रस्ताव से मौलिक रूप से अलग है।

segments.src: Others counter that the scale, specificity, and direct linkage to control of Congress make this proposal different from ordinary campaign promises about future legislation, and that it deserves close examination by election law authorities and, potentially, the courts.
segments.tr: अन्य लोग यह मुकाबला करते हैं कि कांग्रेस के नियंत्रण के लिए पैमाने, विशिष्टता और प्रत्यक्ष संबंध इस प्रस्ताव को भविष्य के कानून के बारे में साधारण अभियान के वादों से अलग बनाते हैं, और यह कि यह चुनाव कानून अधिकारियों और संभावित रूप से अदालतों द्वारा करीबी परीक्षा का हकदार है।

segments.src: ## Bipartisan Pushback
segments.tr: ## Bipartisan Pushback

segments.src: The reaction has not broken along entirely predictable lines.
segments.tr: प्रतिक्रिया पूरी तरह से अनुमानित लाइनों के साथ नहीं टूटी है।

segments.src: While Democratic lawmakers have criticized the plan as fiscally irresponsible and legally dubious, a number of Republican members of Congress and fiscal conservatives have also voiced skepticism — some questioning whether the federal government can responsibly fund a trillion-dollar-plus payment without deepening the deficit, and others expressing discomfort with a proposal that so explicitly ties a taxpayer payment to their own party's electoral success.
segments.tr: जबकि डेमोक्रेटिक कानून निर्माताओं ने इस योजना को राजकोषीय रूप से गैरजिम्मेदाराना और कानूनी रूप से संदिग्ध के रूप में आलोचना की है, कांग्रेस के कई रिपब्लिकन सदस्यों और राजकोषीय रूढ़िवादियों ने भी संदेह व्यक्त किया है — कुछ ने यह सवाल किया है कि क्या संघीय सरकार घाटे को गहरा किए बिना ट्रिलियन डॉलर से अधिक के भुगतान को जिम्मेदारी से वित्त पोषित कर सकती है, और अन्य ने एक ऐसे प्रस्ताव के साथ असुविधा व्यक्त की है जो करदाता के भुगतान को उनकी अपनी पार्टी की चुनावी सफलता से इतनी स्पष्ट रूप से जोड़ता है।

segments.src: Congressional appropriators have noted that any payment of this size would almost certainly require legislation, meaning the pledge itself cannot be unilaterally implemented by the executive branch regardless of the November results.
segments.tr: कांग्रेसी विनियोगकर्ताओं ने नोट किया है कि इस आकार के किसी भी भुगतान के लिए लगभग निश्चित रूप से कानून की आवश्यकता होगी, जिसका अर्थ है कि नवंबर के परिणामों की परवाह किए बिना कार्यकारी शाखा द्वारा प्रतिज्ञा को एकपक्षीय रूप से लागू नहीं किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: That reality has led some observers to describe the promise as more of a campaign message than a fully formed policy proposal at this stage.
segments.tr: उस वास्तविकता ने कुछ पर्यवेक्षकों को इस चरण में पूरी तरह से गठित नीतिगत प्रस्ताव की तुलना में अधिक अभियान संदेश के रूप में वादे का वर्णन करने के लिए प्रेरित किया है।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## What Comes Next

segments.src: For now, the $5,000 dividend remains a pledge rather than enacted policy.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, $5,000 लाभांश अधिनियमित नीति के बजाय एक प्रतिज्ञा बना हुआ है।

segments.src: Whether it advances will depend on the makeup of the next Congress, the willingness of lawmakers from both parties to bring it to a vote, and how election law questions around its framing are ultimately resolved.
segments.tr: क्या यह आगे बढ़ता है, यह अगली कांग्रेस की बनावट, इसे वोट के लिए लाने के लिए दोनों पक्षों के कानून निर्माताओं की इच्छा, और इसके फ्रेमिंग के आसपास चुनाव कानून के सवालों को अंततः कैसे हल किया जाता है, पर निर्भर करेगा।

segments.src: In the meantime, it has already reshaped part of the midterm conversation, forcing candidates in both parties to answer questions about tariff policy, federal spending, and the boundaries of what a campaign can promise voters in exchange for their support.
segments.tr: इस बीच, इसने पहले ही मध्यावधि बातचीत के हिस्से को नया रूप दे दिया है, दोनों पक्षों के उम्मीदवारों को टैरिफ नीति, संघीय खर्च और इस बात की सीमाओं के बारे में सवालों के जवाब देने के लिए मजबूर कर दिया है कि एक अभियान अपने समर्थन के बदले में मतदाताओं से क्या वादा कर सकता है।

segments.src: As with any major fiscal proposal introduced ahead of an election, voters are encouraged to look past the headline number and examine the underlying funding mechanism, the legislative steps required, and the independent analyses of its costs and legal standing before drawing conclusions about its likelihood or fairness.
segments.tr: चुनाव से पहले पेश किए जाने वाले किसी भी प्रमुख राजकोषीय प्रस्ताव की तरह, मतदाताओं को सुर्खियों की संख्या से परे देखने और इसकी संभावना या निष्पक्षता के बारे में निष्कर्ष निकालने से पहले अंतर्निहित वित्त पोषण तंत्र, आवश्यक विधायी चरणों और इसकी लागत और कानूनी स्थिति के स्वतंत्र विश्लेषण की जांच करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाता है।

segments.tr: Algunos argumentan que una promesa de política amplia hecha durante una campaña —incluso una ligada a un resultado partidista— es discurso político protegido y fundamentalmente diferente de una oferta ilegal a un votante individual a cambio de una papeleta específica.

segments.src: Others counter that the scale, specificity, and direct linkage to control of Congress make this proposal different from ordinary campaign promises about future legislation, and that it deserves close examination by election law authorities and, potentially, the courts.
segments.tr: Otros replican que la escala, la especificidad y el vínculo directo con el control del Congreso hacen que esta propuesta sea diferente de las promesas de campaña ordinarias sobre legislación futura, y que merece un examen cercano por parte de las autoridades de derecho electoral y, potencialmente, de los tribunales.

segments.src: ## Bipartisan Pushback
segments.tr: ## Oposición bipartidista

segments.src: The reaction has not broken along entirely predictable lines.
segments.tr: La reacción no se ha dividido a lo largo de líneas totalmente predecibles.

segments.src: While Democratic lawmakers have criticized the plan as fiscally irresponsible and legally dubious, a number of Republican members of Congress and fiscal conservatives have also voiced skepticism — some questioning whether the federal government can responsibly fund a trillion-dollar-plus payment without deepening the deficit, and others expressing discomfort with a proposal that so explicitly ties a taxpayer payment to their own party's electoral success.
segments.tr: Si bien los legisladores demócratas han criticado el plan por considerarlo fiscalmente irresponsable y legalmente dudoso, varios miembros republicanos del Congreso y conservadores fiscales también han expresado escepticismo; algunos cuestionan si el gobierno federal puede financiar responsablemente un pago de más de un billón de dólares sin profundizar el déficit, y otros expresan incomodidad con una propuesta que vincula tan explícitamente el pago de los contribuyentes al éxito electoral de su propio partido.

segments.src: Congressional appropriators have noted that any payment of this size would almost certainly require legislation, meaning the pledge itself cannot be unilaterally implemented by the executive branch regardless of the November results.
segments.tr: Los asignadores del Congreso han señalado que cualquier pago de este tamaño requeriría casi con certeza legislación, lo que significa que la promesa en sí no puede ser implementada unilateralmente por la rama ejecutiva independientemente de los resultados de noviembre.

segments.src: That reality has led some observers to describe the promise as more of a campaign message than a fully formed policy proposal at this stage.
segments.tr: Esa realidad ha llevado a algunos observadores a describir la promesa como más un mensaje de campaña que una propuesta de política completamente formada en esta etapa.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sigue

segments.src: For now, the $5,000 dividend remains a pledge rather than enacted policy.
segments.tr: Por ahora, el dividendo de $5,000 sigue siendo una promesa más que una política promulgada.

segments.src: Whether it advances will depend on the makeup of the next Congress, the willingness of lawmakers from both parties to bring it to a vote, and how election law questions around its framing are ultimately resolved.
segments.tr: Si avanza dependerá de la composición del próximo Congreso, la disposición de los legisladores de ambos partidos para llevarlo a votación y cómo se resuelvan finalmente las cuestiones de derecho electoral en torno a su encuadre.

segments.src: In the meantime, it has already reshaped part of the midterm conversation, forcing candidates in both parties to answer questions about tariff policy, federal spending, and the boundaries of what a campaign can promise voters in exchange for their support.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, ya ha reformado parte de la conversación de mitad de mandato, obligando a los candidatos de ambos partidos a responder preguntas sobre la política arancelaria, el gasto federal y los límites de lo que una campaña puede prometer a los votantes a cambio de su apoyo.

segments.src: As with any major fiscal proposal introduced ahead of an election, voters are encouraged to look past the headline number and examine the underlying funding mechanism, the legislative steps required, and the independent analyses of its costs and legal standing before drawing conclusions about its likelihood or fairness.
segments.tr: Como con cualquier propuesta fiscal importante introducida antes de una elección, se alienta a los votantes a mirar más allá de la cifra principal y examinar el mecanismo de financiación subyacente, los pasos legislativos requeridos y los análisis independientes de sus costos y situación legal antes de sacar conclusiones sobre su probabilidad o equidad.

ar.title: $1.2 Trillion and One Legal Question: Inside Trump's $5,000 Midterm "Dividend" Pledge

segments.src: ## A Big Promise, Tied to a Ballot Box Outcome
segments.tr: ## وعد كبير، مرتبط بنتيجة صندوق الاقتراع

segments.src: President Trump has pledged that every American adult would receive a $5,000 payment — a so-called "dividend" — if Republicans retain control of both chambers of Congress in the November midterm elections.
segments.tr: تعهد الرئيس ترامب بأن يتلقى كل بالغ أمريكي دفعة بقيمة 5,000 دولار — وهي ما تسمى "توزيعات أرباح" — إذا احتفظ الجمهوريون السيطرة على كلا مجلسي الكونغرس في انتخابات التجديد النصفي في نوفمبر.

segments.src: The proposal, floated as part of a broader argument that tariff revenue collected over the past several years has generated a windfall for the federal government, has quickly become one of the most talked-about economic storylines heading into the fall campaign season.
segments.tr: هذا المقترح، الذي تم طرحه كجزء من نقاش أوسع حول أن عائدات الرسوم الجمركية التي تم جمعها خلال السنوات القليلة الماضية قد ولدت مكاسب غير متوقعة للحكومة الفيدرالية، أصبح بسرعة واحدًا من أكثر القصص الاقتصادية التي تحدث عنها الجميع في موسم الحملات الانتخابية الخريفية.

segments.src: Supporters frame the payment as a straightforward return of money already collected through tariffs on imported goods, arguing that if consumers and businesses have effectively borne the cost of those tariffs, it is only fair that some of that revenue flow back to households.
segments.tr: يؤطر المؤيدون المدفوعات باعتبارها إعادة مباشرة للمال الذي تم جمعه بالفعل من خلال الرسوم الجمركية على السلع المستوردة، جادلين بأنه إذا كان المستهلكون والشركات قد تحملوا بفعالية تكلفة تلك الرسوم الجمركية، فمن العدل فقط أن يتدفق بعض تلك الإيرادات مرة أخرى إلى الأسر.

segments.src: Critics, however, say the math, the funding mechanism, and the political framing of the offer all raise serious questions that go well beyond a typical stimulus debate.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، يقول النقاد إن الرياضيات، وآلية التمويل، والإطار السياسي للعرض كلها تثير أسئلة جدية تتجاوز بكثير مناقشة التحفيز النموذجية.

segments.src: ## The Price Tag: Roughly $1.2 Trillion
segments.tr: ## ثمن البضاعة: ما يقرب من 1.2 تريليون دولار

segments.src: With more than 230 million adults in the United States, a flat $5,000 payment to each one would cost in the neighborhood of $1.2 trillion — a figure that dwarfs even the largest single rounds of pandemic-era stimulus payments.
segments.tr: مع وجود أكثر من 230 مليون بالغ في الولايات المتحدة، فإن دفعة ثابتة قدرها 5,000 دولار لكل واحد منهم ستكلف حوالي 1.2 تريليون دولار — وهو رقم يتضاءل أمامه حتى أكبر جولات فردية من مدفوعات التحفيز في عصر الوباء.

segments.src: Independent budget analysts have noted that tariff revenue collected to date, while substantial, falls well short of covering a payout at that scale without either new borrowing, cuts elsewhere in the federal budget, or a significant and sustained increase in tariff collections.
segments.tr: وقد أشار محللون ميزانيات مستقلون إلى أن إيرادات الرسوم الجمركية التي تم جمعها حتى الآن، رغم أنها كبيرة، تقصر بشكل كبير عن تغطية دفع بهذا الحجم دون إما اقتراض جديد، أو تخفيضات في مكان آخر في الميزانية الفيدرالية، أو زيادة كبيرة ومستدامة في مجموعات الرسوم الجمركية.

segments.src: That gap is at the center of the fiscal debate.
segments.tr: تلك الفجوة في مركز النقاش المالي.

segments.src: Economists across the political spectrum have cautioned that tariffs are ultimately paid in large part by American importers and consumers through higher prices, meaning a "dividend" funded this way could function less like a windfall rebate and more like a redistribution of costs that were already being passed on to the public.
segments.tr: حذر اقتصاديون عبر الطيف السياسي من أن الرسوم الجمركية يتم دفعها في نهاية المطاف في الغالب من قبل المستوردين والمستهلكين الأمريكيين من خلال أسعار أعلى، مما يعني أن "توزيعات الأرباح" المُمولة بهذه الطريقة يمكن أن تعمل بشكل أقل مثل خصم غير متوقع وأكثر مثل إعادة توزيع التكاليف التي كانت تمر بالفعل على الجمهور.

segments.src: Others have raised concerns about inflationary pressure if a payment of this size were to reach the economy all at once.
segments.tr: وقد أثار آخرون مخاوف بشأن الضغط التضخمي إذا وصلت دفعة بهذا الحجم إلى الاقتصاد دفعة واحدة.

segments.src: ## The Legal Question: Can a Payment Be Tied to an Election Outcome?
segments.tr: ## المسألة القانونية: هل يمكن ربط الدفع بنتيجة الانتخابات؟

segments.src: Beyond the budget arithmetic, the proposal has drawn scrutiny over a more fundamental issue: whether explicitly conditioning a federal payment on the outcome of a congressional election crosses a legal line.
segments.tr: إلى جانب حسابات الميزانية، جذب المقترح تدقيقًا حول قضية أكثر أساسية: ما إذا كان اشتراط الدفع الفيدرالي صراحة على نتيجة انتخابات الكونغرس يعبر خطًا قانونيًا.

segments.src: Federal law generally prohibits offering or providing something of value in exchange for voting, or for voting a particular way, and election law specialists have pointed out that a pledge structured as "you get this payment if this party wins" sits in genuinely untested legal territory.
segments.tr: يحظر القانون الفيدرالي بشكل عام تقديم أو توفير شيء من القيمة مقابل التصويت، أو مقابل التصويت بطريقة معينة، وأشار متخصصو قانون الانتخاب إلى أن التعهد المهيكل مثل "تحصل على هذه الدفعة إذا فاز هذا الحزب" يجلس في أراضي قانونية لم يتم اختبارها حقًا.

segments.src: Legal scholars are divided on how such a case would actually be analyzed.
segments.tr: العلماء القانونيون منقسمون حول كيف سيتم تحليل هذه القضية في الواقع.

segments.src: Some argue that a broad policy promise made during a campaign — even one tied to a partisan outcome — is protected political speech and fundamentally different from an illegal offer to an individual voter in exchange for a specific ballot.
segments.tr: يزعم البعض أن وعد سياسي واسع تم إجراؤه خلال حملة — حتى لو كان مرتبطًا بنتيجة حزبية — هو خطاب سياسي محمي ومختلف بشكل أساسي عن عرض غير قانوني لناخب فرد مقابل ورقة اقتراع محددة.

segments.src: Others counter that the scale, specificity, and direct linkage to control of Congress make this proposal different from ordinary campaign promises about future legislation, and that it deserves close examination by election law authorities and, potentially, the courts.
segments.tr: يرد آخرون بأن الحجم والخصوصية والارتباط المباشر بالسيطرة على الكونغرس يجعل هذا المقترح مختلفًا عن وعود الحملة العادية حول التشريعات المستقبلية، وأنه يستحق فحصًا دقيقًا من قبل سلطات قانون الانتخاب وربما المحاكم.

segments.src: ## Bipartisan Pushback
segments.tr: ## الدفع العكسي الحزبي المتبادل

segments.src: The reaction has not broken along entirely predictable lines.
segments.tr: لم تنكسر ردة الفعل على طول الخطوط المتوقعة تمامًا.

segments.src: While Democratic lawmakers have criticized the plan as fiscally irresponsible and legally dubious, a number of Republican members of Congress and fiscal conservatives have also voiced skepticism — some questioning whether the federal government can responsibly fund a trillion-dollar-plus payment without deepening the deficit, and others expressing discomfort with a proposal that so explicitly ties a taxpayer payment to their own party's electoral success.
segments.tr: في حين انتقد المشرعون الديمقراطيون الخطة باعتبارها غير مسؤولة مالياً ومشكوكة قانونياً، أعرب عدد من أعضاء الكونغرس الجمهوريين والمحافظين الماليين عن الشكوك أيضاً — بعضهم يتساءل عما إذا كان بإمكان الحكومة الفيدرالية تمويل دفعة تزيد عن تريليون دولار بمسؤولية دون تعميق العجز، وآخرون يعبرون عن عدم الراحة مع مقترح يربط صراحة دفعة دافع الضرائب بالنجاح الانتخابي لحزبهم.

segments.src: Congressional appropriators have noted that any payment of this size would almost certainly require legislation, meaning the pledge itself cannot be unilaterally implemented by the executive branch regardless of the November results.
segments.tr: لاحظ المخصصون في الكونغرس أن أي دفعة بهذا الحجم ستتطلب على الأرجح تشريعًا، مما يعني أن التعهد نفسه لا يمكن تنفيذه بشكل أحادي من قبل الفرع التنفيذي بغض النظر عن نتائج نوفمبر.

segments.src: That reality has led some observers to describe the promise as more of a campaign message than a fully formed policy proposal at this stage.
segments.tr: تلك الواقعة أدت ببعض المراقبين إلى وصف الوعد بأنه رسالة حملة أكثر من كونها مقترح سياسي مكتمل الصياغة في هذه المرحلة.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## ما يأتي بعد ذلك

segments.src: For now, the $5,000 dividend remains a pledge rather than enacted policy.
segments.tr: حتى الآن، تظل توزيعات الأرباح بقيمة 5,000 دولار تعهدًا بدلاً من سياسة مفعلة.

segments.src: Whether it advances will depend on the makeup of the next Congress, the willingness of lawmakers from both parties to bring it to a vote, and how election law questions around its framing are ultimately resolved.
segments.tr: ما إذا كانت ستتقدم فسيعتمد على تشكيل الكونغرس القادم، واستعداد المشرعين من كلا الحزبين لجلبها للتصويت، وكيف يتم حل أسئلة قانون الانتخاب حول تأطيرها في نهاية المطاف.

segments.src: In the meantime, it has already reshaped part of the midterm conversation, forcing candidates in both parties to answer questions about tariff policy, federal spending, and the boundaries of what a campaign can promise voters in exchange for their support.
segments.tr: في هذه الأثناء، أعادت تشكيل جزء من محادثة التجديد النصفي بالفعل، مما أجبر المرشحين في كلا الحزبين على الإجابة عن أسئلة حول سياسة الرسوم الجمركية، والإنفاق الفيدرالي، وحدود ما يمكن للحملة أن تعد به الناخبين مقابل دعمهم.

segments.src: As with any major fiscal proposal introduced ahead of an election, voters are encouraged to look past the headline number and examine the underlying funding mechanism, the legislative steps required, and the independent analyses of its costs and legal standing before drawing conclusions about its likelihood or fairness.
segments.tr: كما هو الحال مع أي مقترح مالي رئيسي تم تقديمه قبل الانتخابات، يُشجع الناخبون على النظر إلى ما وراء رقم العنوان الرئيسي وفحص آليات التمويل الأساسية، والخطوات التشريعية المطلوبة، والتحليلات المستقلة لتكاليفه ووضعه القانوني قبل استخلاص النتائج حول احتماليته أو عدالته.

segments.src: ## The Legal Question: Can a Payment Be Tied to an Election Outcome?

segments.tr: La loi fédérale interdit généralement d'offrir ou de fournir quelque chose de valeur en échange d'un vote, ou d'un vote dans un sens particulier, et les spécialistes du droit électoral ont souligné qu'une promesse structurée sous la forme « vous recevez ce paiement si ce parti gagne » se situe dans un territoire juridique totalement inexploré.

segments.tr: Les juristes sont partagés sur la manière dont une telle affaire serait réellement analysée.

segments.src: Others counter that the scale, specificity, and direct linkage to control of Congress make this proposal different from ordinary campaign promises about future legislation, and that it deserves close examination by election law authorities and, potentially, the courts.
segments.tr: D'autres rétorquent que l'ampleur, la spécificité et le lien direct avec le contrôle du Congrès distinguent cette proposition des promesses de campagne ordinaires concernant de futures lois, et qu'elle mérite un examen attentif de la part des autorités du droit électoral et, potentiellement, des tribunaux.

segments.tr: Son avancement dépendra de la composition du prochain Congrès, de la volonté des législateurs des deux partis de le soumettre au vote, et de la manière dont les questions de droit électoral entourant sa formulation seront finalement résolues.

segments.src: In the meantime, it has already reshaped part of the midterm conversation, forcing candidates in both parties to answer questions about tariff policy, federal spending, and the boundaries of what a campaign can promise voters in exchange for their support.
segments.tr: En attendant, elle a déjà redessiné une partie du débat des élections de mi-mandat, obligeant les candidats des deux partis à répondre à des questions sur la politique tarifaire, les dépenses fédérales et les limites de ce qu'une campagne peut promettre aux électeurs en échange de leur soutien.

segments.src: As with any major fiscal proposal introduced ahead of an election, voters are encouraged to look past the headline number and examine the underlying funding mechanism, the legislative steps required, and the independent analyses of its costs and legal standing before drawing conclusions about its likelihood or fairness.
segments.tr: Comme pour toute proposition budgétaire majeure présentée avant une élection, les électeurs sont encouragés à regarder au-delà du chiffre annoncé et à examiner le mécanisme de financement sous-jacent, les étapes législatives requises, ainsi que les analyses indépendantes de ses coûts et de sa validité juridique avant de tirer des conclusions sur sa faisabilité ou sa justice.

pt.title: US$ 1,2 Trilhão e Uma Questão Legal: Por Dentro da Promessa de "Dividendo" de US$ 5.000 de Trump para as Midterms

segments.src: ## A Big Promise, Tied to a Ballot Box Outcome
segments.tr: ## Uma Grande Promessa, Vinculada ao Resultado das Urnas

segments.src: President Trump has pledged that every American adult would receive a $5,000 payment — a so-called "dividend" — if Republicans retain control of both chambers of Congress in the November midterm elections.
segments.tr: O presidente Trump prometeu que cada adulto americano receberia um pagamento de US$ 5.000 — um chamado "dividendo" — se os republicanos mantiverem o controle de ambas as câmaras do Congresso nas eleições de meio de mandato de novembro.

segments.src: The proposal, floated as part of a broader argument that tariff revenue collected over the past several years has generated a windfall for the federal government, has quickly become one of the most talked-about economic storylines heading into the fall campaign season.
segments.tr: A proposta, apresentada como parte de um argumento mais amplo de que a receita de tarifas arrecadada nos últimos anos gerou um ganho inesperado para o governo federal, tornou-se rapidamente uma das histórias econômicas mais comentadas no período que antecede a campanha de outono.

segments.src: Supporters frame the payment as a straightforward return of money already collected through tariffs on imported goods, arguing that if consumers and businesses have effectively borne the cost of those tariffs, it is only fair that some of that revenue flow back to households.
segments.tr: Os apoiadores apresentam o pagamento como um retorno direto do dinheiro já arrecadado por meio de tarifas sobre produtos importados, argumentando que, se os consumidores e as empresas arcaram efetivamente com o custo dessas tarifas, é justo que parte dessa receita retorne às famílias.

segments.src: Critics, however, say the math, the funding mechanism, and the political framing of the offer all raise serious questions that go well beyond a typical stimulus debate.
segments.tr: Os críticos, no entanto, dizem que os cálculos, o mecanismo de financiamento e a enquadramento político da oferta levantam sérias dúvidas que vão muito além de um debate típico sobre estímulos econômicos.

segments.src: ## The Price Tag: Roughly $1.2 Trillion
segments.tr: ## O Custo: Aprox. US$ 1,2 Trilhão

segments.src: With more than 230 million adults in the United States, a flat $5,000 payment to each one would cost in the neighborhood of $1.2 trillion — a figure that dwarfs even the largest single rounds of pandemic-era stimulus payments.
segments.tr: Com mais de 230 milhões de adultos nos Estados Unidos, um pagamento uniforme de US$ 5.000 para cada um custaria algo em torno de US$ 1,2 trilhão — uma cifra que supera até mesmo as maiores rodadas individuais de pagamentos de estímulo da era da pandemia.

segments.src: Independent budget analysts have noted that tariff revenue collected to date, while substantial, falls well short of covering a payout at that scale without either new borrowing, cuts elsewhere in the federal budget, or a significant and sustained increase in tariff collections.
segments.tr: Analistas orçamentários independentes destacaram que a receita de tarifas arrecadada até o momento, embora substancial, fica muito aquém de cobrir um pagamento nessa escala sem novos empréstimos, cortes em outras áreas do orçamento federal ou um aumento significativo e sustentado na arrecadação de tarifas.

segments.src: That gap is at the center of the fiscal debate.
segments.tr: Essa lacuna está no centro do debate fiscal.

segments.src: Economists across the political spectrum have cautioned that tariffs are ultimately paid in large part by American importers and consumers through higher prices, meaning a "dividend" funded this way could function less like a windfall rebate and more like a redistribution of costs that were already being passed on to the public.
segments.tr: Economistas de todo o espectro político alertaram que as tarifas são, em grande parte, pagas no final das contas por importadores e consumidores americanos por meio de preços mais altos, o que significa que um "dividendo" financiado dessa forma poderia funcionar menos como um reembolso inesperado e mais como uma redistribuição de custos que já estavam sendo repassados ao público.

segments.src: Others have raised concerns about inflationary pressure if a payment of this size were to reach the economy all at once.
segments.tr: Outros levantaram preocupações sobre a pressão inflacionária caso um pagamento desse porte chegasse à economia de uma só vez.

segments.src: ## The Legal Question: Can a Payment Be Tied to an Election Outcome?
segments.tr: ## A Questão Legal: Um Pagamento Pode Estar Vinculado ao Resultado de Uma Eleição?

segments.src: Beyond the budget arithmetic, the proposal has drawn scrutiny over a more fundamental issue: whether explicitly conditioning a federal payment on the outcome of a congressional election crosses a legal line.
segments.tr: Além da aritmética orçamentária, a proposta atraiu escrutínio sobre uma questão mais fundamental: se condicionar explicitamente um pagamento federal ao resultado de uma eleição congressional cruza uma linha legal.

segments.src: Federal law generally prohibits offering or providing something of value in exchange for voting, or for voting a particular way, and election law specialists have pointed out that a pledge structured as "you get this payment if this party wins" sits in genuinely untested legal territory.
segments.tr: A lei federal geralmente proíbe oferecer ou fornecer algo de valor em troca de votos, ou por votar de uma determinada maneira, e especialistas em direito eleitoral apontaram que uma promessa estruturada como "você recebe este pagamento se este partido vencer" situa-se em um território jurídico verdadeiramente inédito.

segments.src: Legal scholars are divided on how such a case would actually be analyzed.
segments.tr: Juristas estão divididos sobre como tal caso seria realmente analisado.

segments.src: Some argue that a broad policy promise made during a campaign — even one tied to a partisan outcome — is protected political speech and fundamentally different from an illegal offer to an individual voter in exchange for a specific ballot.
segments.tr: Alguns argumentam que uma promessa política ampla feita durante uma campanha — mesmo uma vinculada a um resultado partidário — é discurso político protegido e fundamentalmente diferente de uma oferta ilegal a um eleitor individual em troca de um voto específico.

segments.src: Others counter that the scale, specificity, and direct linkage to control of Congress make this proposal different from ordinary campaign promises about future legislation, and that it deserves close examination by election law authorities and, potentially, the courts.
segments.tr: Outros rebatem que a escala, a especificidade e a ligação direta ao controle do Congresso tornam esta proposta diferente das promessas de campanha ordinárias sobre legislações futuras, e que ela merece um exame minucioso por parte das autoridades de direito eleitoral e, potencialmente, dos tribunais.

segments.src: ## Bipartisan Pushback
segments.tr: ## Resistência Bipartidária

segments.src: The reaction has not broken along entirely predictable lines.
segments.tr: A reação não seguiu linhas inteiramente previsíveis.

segments.src: While Democratic lawmakers have criticized the plan as fiscally irresponsible and legally dubious, a number of Republican members of Congress and fiscal conservatives have also voiced skepticism — some questioning whether the federal government can responsibly fund a trillion-dollar-plus payment without deepening the deficit, and others expressing discomfort with a proposal that so explicitly ties a taxpayer payment to their own party's electoral success.
segments.tr: Enquanto parlamentares democratas criticaram o plano como fiscalmente irresponsável e legalmente duvidoso, vários membros republicanos do Congresso e conservadores fiscais também manifestaram ceticismo — alguns questionando se o governo federal pode financiar com responsabilidade um pagamento de mais de um trilhão de dólares sem aprofundar o déficit, e outros expressando desconforto com uma proposta que vincula tão explicitamente um pagamento aos contribuintes ao sucesso eleitoral de seu próprio partido.

segments.src: Congressional appropriators have noted that any payment of this size would almost certainly require legislation, meaning the pledge itself cannot be unilaterally implemented by the executive branch regardless of the November results.
segments.tr: Integrantes das comissões de orçamento do Congresso observaram que qualquer pagamento desse porte exigiria quase certamente legislação, o que significa que a promessa em si não pode ser implementada unilateralmente pelo poder executivo, independentemente dos resultados de novembro.

segments.src: That reality has led some observers to describe the promise as more of a campaign message than a fully formed policy proposal at this stage.
segments.tr: Essa realidade levou alguns observadores a descrever a promessa mais como uma mensagem de campanha do que como uma proposta política totalmente formada neste estágio.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Vem a Seguir

segments.src: For now, the $5,000 dividend remains a pledge rather than enacted policy.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, o dividendo de US$ 5.000 continua sendo uma promessa em vez de uma política promulgada.

segments.src: Whether it advances will depend on the makeup of the next Congress, the willingness of lawmakers from both parties to bring it to a vote, and how election law questions around its framing are ultimately resolved.
segments.tr: O seu avanço dependerá da composição do próximo Congresso, da disposição dos parlamentares de ambos os partidos em levá-lo a voto e de como as questões de direito eleitoral em torno de seu enquadramento serão finalmente resolvidas.

segments.src: In the meantime, it has already reshaped part of the midterm conversation, forcing candidates in both parties to answer questions about tariff policy, federal spending, and the boundaries of what a campaign can promise voters in exchange for their support.
segments.tr: Enquanto isso, a proposta já remodelou parte das conversas das midterms, forçando candidatos de ambos os partidos a responder a perguntas sobre política tarifária, gastos federais e os limites do que uma campanha pode prometer aos eleitores em troca de seu apoio.

segments.src: As with any major fiscal proposal introduced ahead of an election, voters are encouraged to look past the headline number and examine the underlying funding mechanism, the legislative steps required, and the independent analyses of its costs and legal standing before drawing conclusions about its likelihood or fairness.
segments.tr: Como ocorre com qualquer grande proposta fiscal apresentada antes de uma eleição, os eleitores são incentivados a olhar além do valor de destaque da manchete e examinar o mecanismo de financiamento subjacente, as etapas legislativas necessárias e as análises independentes de seus custos e viabilidade jurídica antes de tirar conclusões sobre sua probabilidade ou justiça.

in.title: $1,2 Triliun dan Satu Pertanyaan Hukum: Di Balik Janji "Dividen" Pemilu Sela $5.000 dari Trump

segments.src: ## A Big Promise, Tied to a Ballot Box Outcome
segments.tr: ## Sebuah Janji Besar, Terikat pada Hasil Kotak Suara

segments.src: The proposal, floated as part of a broader argument that tariff revenue collected over the past several years has generated a windfall for the federal government, has quickly become one of the most talked-about economic storylines heading into the fall campaign season.
segments.tr: Proposal tersebut, yang dilontarkan sebagai bagian dari argumen yang lebih luas bahwa pendapatan tarif yang dikumpulkan selama beberapa tahun terakhir telah menghasilkan keuntungan tak terduga bagi pemerintah federal, dengan cepat menjadi salah satu alur cerita ekonomi yang paling banyak dibicarakan menjelang musim kampanye musim gugur.

segments.src: Supporters frame the payment as a straightforward return of money already collected through tariffs on imported goods, arguing that if consumers and businesses have effectively borne the cost of those tariffs, it is only fair that some of that revenue flow back to households.
segments.tr: Para pendukung membingkai pembayaran tersebut sebagai pengembalian langsung dari uang yang telah dikumpulkan melalui tarif barang impor, dengan argumen bahwa jika konsumen dan bisnis secara efektif telah menanggung biaya tarif tersebut, maka adil jika sebagian dari pendapatan itu mengalir kembali ke rumah tangga.

segments.src: Critics, however, say the math, the funding mechanism, and the political framing of the offer all raise serious questions that go well beyond a typical stimulus debate.
segments.tr: Namun, para kritikus mengatakan bahwa perhitungan matematis, mekanisme pendanaan, dan pembingkaian politik dari tawaran tersebut semuanya menimbulkan pertanyaan serius yang jauh melampaui debat stimulus biasa.

segments.src: ## The Price Tag: Roughly $1.2 Trillion
segments.tr: ## Nilai Anggaran: Sekitar $1,2 Triliun

segments.src: With more than 230 million adults in the United States, a flat $5,000 payment to each one would cost in the neighborhood of $1.2 trillion — a figure that dwarfs even the largest single rounds of pandemic-era stimulus payments.
segments.tr: Dengan lebih dari 230 juta orang dewasa di Amerika Serikat, pembayaran rata sebesar $5.000 kepada masing-masing orang akan menelan biaya sekitar $1,2 triliun — angka yang melampaui putaran pembayaran stimulus tunggal terbesar sekalipun di era pandemi.

segments.src: Independent budget analysts have noted that tariff revenue collected to date, while substantial, falls well short of covering a payout at that scale without either new borrowing, cuts elsewhere in the federal budget, or a significant and sustained increase in tariff collections.
segments.tr: Analis anggaran independen mencatat bahwa pendapatan tarif yang dikumpulkan hingga saat ini, meskipun besar, masih jauh dari cukup untuk menutup pembayaran pada skala tersebut tanpa adanya pinjaman baru, pemotongan di bagian lain anggaran federal, atau peningkatan pengumpulan tarif yang signifikan dan berkelanjutan.

segments.src: That gap is at the center of the fiscal debate.
segments.tr: Kesenjangan itulah yang menjadi pusat perdebatan fiskal.

segments.src: Economists across the political spectrum have cautioned that tariffs are ultimately paid in large part by American importers and consumers through higher prices, meaning a "dividend" funded this way could function less like a windfall rebate and more like a redistribution of costs that were already being passed on to the public.
segments.tr: Para ekonom dari berbagai spektrum politik telah memperingatkan bahwa tarif pada akhirnya sebagian besar dibayar oleh importir dan konsumen Amerika melalui harga yang lebih tinggi, yang berarti "dividen" yang didanai dengan cara ini dapat berfungsi kurang seperti rabat keuntungan tak terduga dan lebih seperti redistribusi biaya yang sudah dibebankan kepada publik.

segments.src: Others have raised concerns about inflationary pressure if a payment of this size were to reach the economy all at once.
segments.tr: Yang lain menyatakan kekhawatiran tentang tekanan inflasi jika pembayaran sebesar ini masuk ke dalam perekonomian sekaligus.

segments.src: ## The Legal Question: Can a Payment Be Tied to an Election Outcome?
segments.tr: ## Pertanyaan Hukum: Bisakah Pembayaran Dikaitkan dengan Hasil Pemilu?

segments.src: Beyond the budget arithmetic, the proposal has drawn scrutiny over a more fundamental issue: whether explicitly conditioning a federal payment on the outcome of a congressional election crosses a legal line.
segments.tr: Di luar perhitungan anggaran, proposal tersebut telah menarik pengawasan atas masalah yang lebih mendasar: apakah secara eksplisit mensyaratkan pembayaran federal pada hasil pemilu kongres melanggar batas hukum.

segments.src: Federal law generally prohibits offering or providing something of value in exchange for voting, or for voting a particular way, and election law specialists have pointed out that a pledge structured as "you get this payment if this party wins" sits in genuinely untested legal territory.
segments.tr: Hukum federal umumnya melarang menawarkan atau memberikan sesuatu yang berharga sebagai imbalan untuk memilih, atau untuk memilih dengan cara tertentu, dan spesialis hukum pemilu telah menunjukkan bahwa janji yang terstruktur seperti "Anda mendapatkan pembayaran ini jika partai ini menang" berada di wilayah hukum yang benar-benar belum teruji.

segments.src: Legal scholars are divided on how such a case would actually be analyzed.
segments.tr: Para pakar hukum terbagi pendapatnya tentang bagaimana kasus seperti itu sebenarnya akan dianalisis.

segments.src: Some argue that a broad policy promise made during a campaign — even one tied to a partisan outcome — is protected political speech and fundamentally different from an illegal offer to an individual voter in exchange for a specific ballot.
segments.tr: Beberapa berpendapat bahwa janji kebijakan luas yang dibuat selama kampanye — bahkan yang dikaitkan dengan hasil partisan — adalah pidato politik yang dilindungi dan secara mendasar berbeda dari tawaran ilegal kepada pemilih individu sebagai imbalan atas surat suara tertentu.

segments.src: Others counter that the scale, specificity, and direct linkage to control of Congress make this proposal different from ordinary campaign promises about future legislation, and that it deserves close examination by election law authorities and, potentially, the courts.
segments.tr: Yang lain membantah bahwa skala, spesifisitas, dan keterkaitan langsung dengan kendali Kongres membuat proposal ini berbeda dari janji kampanye biasa tentang undang-undang di masa depan, dan bahwa hal itu layak mendapatkan pemeriksaan ketat oleh otoritas hukum pemilu dan, berpotensi, pengadilan.

segments.src: ## Bipartisan Pushback
segments.tr: ## Penolakan Bipartisan

segments.src: The reaction has not broken along entirely predictable lines.
segments.tr: Reaksi yang muncul tidak sepenuhnya terbagi berdasarkan garis partai yang dapat diprediksi.

segments.src: While Democratic lawmakers have criticized the plan as fiscally irresponsible and legally dubious, a number of Republican members of Congress and fiscal conservatives have also voiced skepticism — some questioning whether the federal government can responsibly fund a trillion-dollar-plus payment without deepening the deficit, and others expressing discomfort with a proposal that so explicitly ties a taxpayer payment to their own party's electoral success.
segments.tr: Sementara anggota parlemen dari Partai Demokrat mengkritik rencana tersebut sebagai tidak bertanggung jawab secara fiskal dan meragukan secara hukum, sejumlah anggota Kongres dari Partai Republik dan konservatif fiskal juga menyuarakan skeptisisme — beberapa mempertanyakan apakah pemerintah federal dapat mendanai pembayaran bernilai triliunan dolar lebih secara bertanggung jawab tanpa memperdalam defisit, dan yang lain menyatakan ketidaknyamanan dengan proposal yang secara eksplisit mengaitkan pembayaran pembayar pajak dengan keberhasilan pemilu partai mereka sendiri.

segments.src: Congressional appropriators have noted that any payment of this size would almost certainly require legislation, meaning the pledge itself cannot be unilaterally implemented by the executive branch regardless of the November results.
segments.tr: Para penyusun anggaran di Kongres mencatat bahwa pembayaran sebesar ini hampir pasti memerlukan undang-undang, yang berarti janji itu sendiri tidak dapat diterapkan secara sepihak oleh cabang eksekutif terlepas dari hasil pemilu bulan November.

segments.src: That reality has led some observers to describe the promise as more of a campaign message than a fully formed policy proposal at this stage.
segments.tr: Realitas tersebut telah membuat beberapa pengamat menggambarkan janji itu lebih sebagai pesan kampanye daripada proposal kebijakan yang terbentuk sepenuhnya pada tahap ini.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa Langkah Selanjutnya

segments.src: For now, the $5,000 dividend remains a pledge rather than enacted policy.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, dividen $5.000 tetap menjadi janji dan bukan kebijakan yang telah ditetapkan.

segments.src: Whether it advances will depend on the makeup of the next Congress, the willingness of lawmakers from both parties to bring it to a vote, and how election law questions around its framing are ultimately resolved.
segments.tr: Apakah hal itu akan berlanjut akan bergantung pada komposisi Kongres berikutnya, kesediaan anggota parlemen dari kedua partai untuk membawanya ke pemungutan suara, dan bagaimana pertanyaan hukum pemilu seputar pembingkaiannya pada akhirnya diselesaikan.

segments.src: In the meantime, it has already reshaped part of the midterm conversation, forcing candidates in both parties to answer questions about tariff policy, federal spending, and the boundaries of what a campaign can promise voters in exchange for their support.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, hal ini telah membentuk kembali sebagian dari percakapan pemilu sela, memaksa para kandidat di kedua partai untuk menjawab pertanyaan tentang kebijakan tarif, pengeluaran federal, dan batasan dari apa yang dapat dijanjikan oleh kampanye kepada pemilih sebagai imbalan atas dukungan mereka.

segments.src: As with any major fiscal proposal introduced ahead of an election, voters are encouraged to look past the headline number and examine the underlying funding mechanism, the legislative steps required, and the independent analyses of its costs and legal standing before drawing conclusions about its likelihood or fairness.
segments.tr: Seperti halnya proposal fiskal besar lainnya yang diperkenalkan menjelang pemilu, pemilih didorong untuk melihat melampaui angka utama dan memeriksa mekanisme pendanaan yang mendasarinya, langkah-langkah legislatif yang diperlukan, serta analisis independen mengenai biaya dan kedudukan hukumnya sebelum menarik kesimpulan tentang kemungkinan atau keadilannya.
